passage.text: The officers followed to check the soldiers and were involuntarily drawn into doing the same. The few inhabitants who had remained invited commanding officers to their houses, hoping thereby to secure themselves from being plundered. All around the quarters occupied by the French were other regions still unexplored and unoccupied where, they thought, yet greater riches might be found. The French attributed the Fire of Moscow au patriotisme féroce de Rostopchíne, * the Russians to the barbarity of the French. In reality, however, it was not, and could not be, possible to explain the burning of Moscow by making any individual, or any group of people, responsible for it.
